name: Esaar (India) Limited
about: Esaar (India) Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides asset finance services in India. The company offers retail credit, such as home, business, personal, education, vehicle, demand, project, and commercial property loans, as well as agri and rural financing, loan against securities, lease rental discounting, and loan against property. It also provides start up loans, mentorship, and seed funding. In addition, the company is involved in share trading and financing business. Esaar (India) Limited was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
